name: lorikam-infra
description: Railway infrastructure-as-code + deploy scripts for Lorikam. The apps have their own package.json and Yarn 4 lockfile: lorikam/ (Medusa backend, deployed here to Railway) and lorikam-storefront/ (Next.js, deployed to Vercel). The only dependency is the railway SDK, which .railway/railway.ts imports.

scripts.vars: npm run railway -- variables list --service backend
scripts.migrate: npm run railway -- ssh --service backend -- sh -lc "yarn medusa db:migrate"
scripts.domain: npm run railway -- domain status api.lorikam.ro --service backend
